text:
**Often, yes—but not always.** Bundles can be cheaper when the manufacturer discounts the panel and power station together. For example, one price check found a BLUETTI AC180 kit at **$649**, compared with **$748** for the same parts separately—a **$99 saving** ([PowerSized](https://powersized.com/solar-generator-kits/)). Another listed an EcoFlow bundle at **$669**, **$179 less** than its separate parts.

But separate purchases can win if the power station or a compatible third-party panel is on sale. Compare the bundle with the *same components* bought separately, and check the panel’s voltage and connector compatibility before choosing ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/solar-generator-kit-vs-buying-separately)).

judge.top_pick: BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W Solar Panel Kit
